## Decision

Fix readMotiveDecisionEvents field loss before running any reconciliation. It drops rationale, alternatives, status and kind — fields the planner contract validates.

## Rationale

Migrating into a broken read path produces a store that is complete on disk and still wrong when compiled. That state is harder to detect than the current loud emptiness (STORE_DIVERGENCE guard fires on read). Fix first, then migrate.

## Alternatives Considered

- Migrate first and fix read path after — rejected, wrong-but-stable output is harder to detect than loud emptiness
